fields.label: API Version
fields.help: API version displayed in Dialogflow console.

fields.label: Avatar Uri
fields.help: The URI of the agent's avatar, which are used throughout the Dialogflow console.

fields.label: Classification Threshold
fields.help: To filter out false positive results and still get variety in matched natural language inputs for your agent, you can tune the machine learning classification threshold.

fields.label: Default Language Code
fields.help: The default language of the agent as a language tag.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Enable Logging
fields.help: Determines whether this agent should log conversation queries.

fields.label: Match Mode
fields.help: Determines how intents are detected from user queries.

fields.label: Supported Language Codes
fields.help: The list of all languages supported by this agent (except for the defaultLanguageCode).

fields.label: Time Zone
fields.help: The time zone of this agent from the [time zone database](https://www.iana.org/time-zones), e.g., America/New_York, Europe/Paris.
